name: notification-center
title: Notification Center
author: Bevel UI <hello@bevelui.vercel.app>
description: Queued, grouped notification system with priority-based toast eviction, pause-on-hover timing, undo, and a persistent inbox separate from the transient toast queue.
docs: Import from @/components/bevelui/notification-center. Wrap your app with NotificationRoot, render NotificationToastViewport for the transient toast queue and NotificationInbox for the persistent list. Use useNotifications to push, group, undo, and dismiss notifications from anywhere in the tree.
